description: Keyword density & on-page SEO — On-page keyword analysis for a URL (or raw text=): word count, unique words, reading time, top keywords/bigrams/trigrams with density (stop words and numbers excluded, phrases never cross sentence breaks), title/meta description/H1/H2 extraction. With keyword= it reports occurrences, density, first position, and whether it appears in the title, meta description, H1, H2s, URL slug and first 100 words, with an OPTIMIZED / UNDER-OPTIMIZED / OVER-OPTIMIZED / MISSING verdict and fix list. Optional: keyword=, text= (instead of url), top= (5-50). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_keyword_density
